notes.title: Ver.1009 Update
notes.notes:
- Increased the number of enemy types.
- Adventure point rewards for clearing floor 50 increased from 20 to 40.
- Bug fixes.

notes.title: Ver. 1.006 Update
notes.notes:
- Changed the equipment scene UI
- Changed the shop scene UI
- Improved mouse usability on equipment and shop scene
- Changed so that the mark on opened treasure chests does not disappear when using "Remove Symbols".
- Removed the function to return to the title screen by pressing the F5 key
- Some text corrections.

notes.title: Ver 1.004 Update
notes.notes:
- Added option feature to colorize "right" and "up".
- Fixed bug causing accelerated playtime depending on environment.
- Changed scoring method for Robbers.
- Increased activation probability of mana items.
- Some text corrections.

notes.title: Ver. 1.003 Update
notes.notes:
Ver. 1.003 Update
- Added Practice mode
- Adjusted Equip Best to Optimal Gear
（Generally equips strong weapons, but switches to weapons that can barely defeat enemies with low HP.）
- Fixed hints from townspeople
- Fixed mistakes in English translation
- Fixed dungeon clear time showing as NaN
- Fixed text when receiving 200 or more Gold so it displays as yellow

notes.title: MIMIC LOGIC RELEASE
notes.notes: Finally the game Mimic Logic is released on Steam!
